# IntrinsicTiming_Plasticity

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
Plasticity driven by the relative timing of spikes within a neuron's intrinsic dynamics rather than global schedules or labels. Supports event-driven, asynchronous learning in TCC/iNEST architectures.
